title: Youth Soccer Team Cohesion
goal: A practitioner can visually assess the Youth Soccer Team Cohesion scenario using its published diagram convention.

rubric.must: Named people are visible as separate nodes and choice relations are visibly directed with arrowheads.
The picture makes the high-in-degree star and the named isolate or peripheral person visibly distinguishable.
At least one reciprocal choice pair is visibly represented as mutual directed selections.
The directed links reveal the stated classroom, team, study, sport, moderation, or project communication pattern.
Names and arrow directions remain legible without a separate source legend.
